column1: # findings-probe suppression list. Generalises docs/misra/misra-suppressions.txt's
# own policy across every tool in build/findings.sarif, not cppcheck alone.
# Format: tool<TAB>rule<TAB>file-glob<TAB>justification, one entry per line.
#   tool          exact SARIF tool.driver.name (for example "Cppcheck",
#                 "clang-tidy", "GNU C23"), or "*" for any tool.
#   rule          exact ruleId, or an fnmatch glob (for example "misra-c2012-*").
#   file-glob     an fnmatch glob against the repo-relative file path.
#   justification "D-NN" naming a deviation record under docs/misra/deviations/,
#                 or "defect:<tool>:<id>" naming a documented checker defect.
#                 A row whose justification matches neither shape makes
#                 scripts/findings_probe.sh RED -- see tools/findings_gate.py's
#                 own docstring. Put the decision in a deviation record first;
#                 a suppression with no justification is not a suppression, it
#                 is silence.
# Empty today: scripts/findings-baseline.tsv already accepts every finding
# present at the time findings-probe was added (task 17), so nothing here
# needs a SEPARATE, permanent exclusion yet. Add a row only for a finding
# that should never count again regardless of the baseline -- for example a
# checker defect this repository has already diagnosed under
# docs/misra/misra-suppressions.txt's own "Checker defects" section.
